scope: comparison of known development mechanisms, not new independent case analysis
shared: common contract evaluator and external review ledger

mechanisms.name: CPU topology preparation
mechanisms.relation: set coverage, preparation qualification and consumption stage
mechanisms.specialized_facts: topology objects, prepare paths, lock aliases and actual consumption window
mechanisms.cannot_borrow_from_source_export: a reviewed native macro does not establish object readiness

mechanisms.name: CPU source-qualified export
mechanisms.relation: purpose/version determines allowed provider origin; publication requires compiled and linked entities
mechanisms.specialized_facts: CPP definition order, reviewed bodies, attribute/callback graph, image and publication binding
mechanisms.open: historical textual provenance, physical values and lifecycle

mechanisms.name: Btrfs geometry
mechanisms.relation: prepared geometry and numeric clipping/file behavior under use-specific gates
mechanisms.specialized_facts: geometry sources, cached operands, option parsing and file layout
mechanisms.cannot_borrow_from_source_export: source body/image equivalence does not establish a same-deadline geometry reference

mechanisms.name: SMMU invalidation
mechanisms.relation: range/encoding, object state and command submission order
mechanisms.cannot_borrow_from_source_export: compiled command path is not hardware invalidation completion

mechanisms.name: virtio DMA buffer
mechanisms.relation: actual backend/maintenance target/range and ownership interval
mechanisms.specialized_facts: actual ABI/base, coherency, effective maintenance granule, mapping and recycle trace
mechanisms.cannot_borrow_from_source_export: image/callback binding is not noncoherent device/cache behavior
